business_summary: Enviri Corporation provides environmental solutions for industrial and specialty waste streams in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: Harsco Environmental, Clean Earth, and Harsco Rail. The Harsco Environmental segment offers on-site environmental services for the management of waste and byproduct streams from its customers, which includes resource recovery and recycling of waste materials, materials handling and logistical support, and aluminum dross and scrap management. This segment also manufactures value-added downstream products from industrial waste streams and ecoproducts, which include road surfacing materials, metallurgical additives, agriculture and turf products, and cement additives. The Clean Earth segment provides specialty waste processing solutions, including treatment, recycling, and beneficial reuse of hazardous and non-hazardous wastes and processing of contaminated soil and dredged materials for customers in the industrial, retail, healthcare, and construction industries. The Harsco Rail segment offers railway track maintenance equipment and services, as well as railway maintenance services to railways, mass transit systems, and equipment leasing companies. Its products include engineered railway, rail treatment, tie, and utility track vehicles, new track construction equipment, after-market parts and services, and safety and diagnostics technology systems; and meltshop and furnace services, such as under-vessel cleaning, removal of ladle slag, and general melt shop debris. The company was formerly known as Harsco Corporation and changed its name to Enviri Corporation in June 2023. The company was founded in 1853 and is headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.
business_summary_ko: Enviri Corporation은 미국 및 국제적으로 산업 및 특수 폐기물 흐름을 위한 환경 솔루션을 제공합니다. Harsco Environmental, Clean Earth 및 Harsco Rail의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. Harsco 환경 부문은 자원 회수 및 폐기물 재활용, 자재 취급 및 물류 지원, 알루미늄 드로스 및 스크랩 관리를 포함하여 고객의 폐기물 및 부산물 흐름 관리를 위한 현장 환경 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 도로 표면 재료, 야금 첨가제, 농업 및 잔디 제품, 시멘트 첨가제를 포함하는 산업 폐기물 흐름 및 친환경 제품에서 부가가치가 높은 다운스트림 제품을 제조합니다. Clean Earth 부문은 산업, 소매, 의료 및 건설 산업 고객을 위한 유해 및 비유해 폐기물의 처리, 재활용, 유익한 재사용, 오염된 토양 및 준설 물질 처리 등을 포함한 특수 폐기물 처리 솔루션을 제공합니다. Harsco Rail 부문은 철도 선로 유지 관리 장비 및 서비스는 물론 철도, 대중 교통 시스템에 대한 철도 유지 관리 서비스도 제공합니다.
